# Wardrobe artwork prompts

Tool: built-in image generation. References: approved Ashen Wayfarer Concept 01 four-view sheet and the generated Modern Stranger sheet.

## Modern Stranger concept

Use case: stylized-concept. Create THE MODERN STRANGER, complementary prologue character sheet to the provided approved Ashen Wayfarer four-view concept. The provided image is the identity/style reference, not an outfit to preserve.
Preserve EXACT same adult protagonist face, dark tousled short hair, anatomy, height and body proportions, painterly gothic production concept-art style, parchment background, typography, four full-body orthographic turnaround layout and palette swatches. The SAME person immediately after falling from the modern world through the Abyssal Gate, before acquiring medieval clothes. No medieval armor or weapons.
Four equal-size full-body unarmed views in one horizontal row: FRONT straight-on, LEFT strict profile facing left, BACK straight rear, RIGHT strict profile facing right. Align heads and feet. Preserve asymmetry across views, do not mirror the side views.
Outfit: oversized contemporary charcoal zip-up hooded windbreaker with hood DOWN, battered by void transition, scuffed smoke-gray hoodie layer, faded dark slate jeans with a patched torn knee, dirty off-white and charcoal modern lace-up sneakers. Modern square wristwatch on anatomical LEFT wrist, a small modern black nylon crossbody messenger bag on anatomical LEFT hip. Soot and ash concentrated on shoulders, cuffs, hems and shoes, a few scorched fabric tears, grounded and readable, no overt magical effects. Tired and confused expression. Retain recognizably modern zippers, sneaker soles, nylon straps, modern seams, subtle reflective windbreaker piping. Contemporary personal belongings look foreign in a medieval world. No logos or trademarks. No medieval shoulder plate, tunic, cloak, boots, belt weapons, deity insignia, fantasy smartphone UI.
Lower strip: three small separate belongings, a broken black smartphone with a visibly cracked glass screen, an empty dented stainless-steel thermos and a tattered contemporary spiral-bound notebook. No sword, potion, atlas in this modern sheet. Six restrained swatches charcoal, slate, ash gray, faded denim, nylon black and dirty off-white. Quiet parchment drafting sheet, fully visible feet and heads, no scenery. Large top text 'AETHELGARD', subheading 'THE MODERN STRANGER'; labels 'FRONT', 'LEFT', 'BACK', 'RIGHT'; lower heading 'STARTER GIFTS'; footer 'PROLOGUE OUTFIT — CONCEPT 01'. Landscape 3:2, high-quality original character concept matching the reference's finish.

## portrait-modern

Create a production dialogue portrait of THE MODERN STRANGER, the EXACT same adult protagonist shown in the provided four-view concept. Use the image as identity, costume and art-style reference. Single head-and-upper-chest bust, three-quarter view looking slightly right, confused exhausted expression, short tousled dark hair, soot on cheeks, subtle under-eye fatigue, charcoal modern hooded windbreaker and ash-gray hoodie with hood DOWN, modern nylon messenger-bag strap. Preserve facial features and proportions. Same crisp hand-painted gothic concept illustration, controlled contours and shading, dark restrained palette, readable warm skin, no neon. Center the whole head with comfortable margin, face occupies 60% of square. Fully transparent background with real alpha, no ground shadow, no scene, no frame, no border, no text, no logos, no palette chips. It will be delivered as a 256x256 dialogue PNG; design legibly for that size. One face only, not a turnaround.

## portrait-wayfarer

Create a production dialogue portrait of THE ASHEN WAYFARER, the EXACT same adult protagonist shown in the provided approved four-view concept. Single head-and-upper-chest bust, three-quarter view looking slightly right, resolute calm expression, preserve short tousled dark hair, same facial features, age, anatomy and muted ash-stained palette. Wear the same medieval charcoal mantle, weathered iron LEFT shoulder pauldron and leather strap. Raise the cloak HOOD over the head but leave the human face and hair clearly visible. Same crisp hand-painted dark fantasy concept illustration, controlled contours and readable shadows. No luminous eyes, no deity insignia, no new jewelry. Square composition, full hood and head comfortable margin, face occupies 60%. Fully transparent real alpha background, no scene, no frame, no border, no text, no logos, no palette chips. Designed for final 256x256 crisp transparent dialogue PNG. One face only.

## player-modern

Use case: stylized-concept, production pixel-animation spritesheet. The attached sheet is a CHARACTER IDENTITY AND OUTFIT REFERENCE, not an output layout reference. Create a UNIFIED side-view 16-bit gothic PIXEL ART animation sheet of the SAME MODERN STRANGER, male/androgynous young adult, dark short hair, charcoal zip-up windbreaker over ash-gray hoodie hood DOWN, faded denim jeans with torn knee, dirty offwhite sneakers, square wristwatch, small dark nylon satchel. Unarmed; no sword, cloak, pauldron or medieval boots. All figures face RIGHT strict side-view and are identical anatomy, scale and palette. Human proportions, readable pixel clusters, 24-32 restrained colors, no antialias or painterly details.
EXACT SHEET LAYOUT: SIX equal-width columns by THREE equal-height rows, no outer margin, no gutters, no dividing lines. Every cell corresponds to a native 64x64 frame, designed with the standing character about 48 pixels tall, base centered at native pixel x32, feet baseline y60. Keep ALL content entirely within each cell, ample clear space around arms/legs. Preview at 4x nearest-neighbor (1536 wide x768 high); individual displayed cells are 256x256 representing 64x64 native pixels. Entire background genuinely TRANSPARENT alpha, not white, not gray, not checkerboard, no shadows.
ROW 1: four distinct gentle IDLE breathing frames in columns1-4, columns5-6 completely EMPTY TRANSPARENT.
ROW 2: six distinct WALK loop frames columns1-6 in temporal order: right foot contact, down, passing, left foot contact, down, passing. Natural opposite arm swing; body height stable with at most1 nativepixel bob; feet do not slide across frame.
ROW 3: four distinct RUN/DASH poses columns1-4 in temporal order: forward lean right contact, airborne passing, left contact, airborne recovery. Columns5-6 EMPTY TRANSPARENT.
No text, labels, numbers, outlines around cells, UI, scenery, props or palette swatches. Not fourteen portraits: actual side-view animated whole-body pixel sprites with distinct leg and arm poses. Preserve scale and baseline across every frame. NO mirrored views, no front views, no back views.

## Walk correction pass

A targeted image edit preserved the idle and run rows and revised the middle row into contact, down, passing, opposite contact, opposite down and opposite passing poses. The fixed source sheets were then sliced into native production cells.
